text_block_list.text:
Today I have a training session with
Meisho Doto, but...

She's not the type to skip practice,
so it's
likely that she's had another
of her
accidents. I decide to go look for her.

I search around for the better part of an
hour before I finally spot the
shivering,
muddy figure in front of the flower beds.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ohhhh... Urgggh... Pat... pat... pat...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eep!
Ah... T-Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah! W-well, um... I suppose this was
unavoidable... given what
happened. It's
kind of a long story...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-okay!

Together, we wash her muddied jersey and
hang it out to dry. While
we wait, I ask her
to explain what happened.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Well,
I-I thought I'd do some solo training
before our session today,
so... I went for a
jog.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-but I slipped and fell, and while I was
trying to recover, I ended up
falling right
into the flower bed...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Ah,
b-but at least I landed in a spot
where there were no
flowers or other
plants!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
However, my fall left the impression of my
body in the soil, so I was
pat-pat-patting it
in... when you found me...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eep! I-I'm sorry... You must be furious...

She has a reason for her tardiness, so I'm
actually not that mad about
it. However...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh? B-but if you joined me... then it
wouldn't be solo training.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's okay. It's just something I do
from time to time... I don't want
to bother
you any more than I already do...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I mean... My clumsiness caused me to be
late today, and it's
interrupted our training
before, right?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Like the time I tried to organize your
files and erased all our training
records, or
when I tried to help prepare the course
and ran myself
over with the turf roller...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Or the time I covered you in sand, or when
I spilled the water all over
you... And the
incident with the towel and the zipper and
the explosion and the—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: No, you don't!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I've caused so,
so much trouble for you... I
don't want to take up any
more of your
time than I already do!

It's true that her clumsiness is out of
this world, but she always takes
responsibility
for any tardiness or other issues it
causes. Besides...
I'm her trainer. She's supposed to take up my time. In fact, as long as it's for her growth, I'd be more than happy to help.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: AAAAAHHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: M-m-my jersey! It's flying away!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah! When I hung up my jersey, I angled it
so that the wind would hit it more! I-I
thought that would help it dry faster, not
make it fly away! I-I
need to catch it!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah! E-excuse me, sorr—Ugyah?! Sorry,
sorry, sorry! C-come back,
jersey!

Before I can stop her, Doto dashes out of
the room, stumbling over
chairs and tables
along the way.

How do I help her understand that it's
okay to "bother" me? I contemplate that
question as I chase after the frantic
Meisho
Doto.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Jerseyyy, slow dooown! Pleeeeas—Oof!
